audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is the entry's answer at every stage — 'Pillar locks him in place', 'Pillar placed on his Alpha Strike exit', 'Pillar him as he exits Alpha Strike', 'your job becomes Pillar peel for your carries'. Highlander's slow immunity is never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Riot: Highlander makes Master Yi 'immune to all slowing effects'. Pillar of Ice's listed effects are impassable terrain plus a slow to all nearby enemies, and Chomp's listed effects include a brief slow. From the moment he presses R, half of Trundle's kit stops touching him — the terrain still stands, but the slow that makes the terrain useful for peeling is gone. An entry that sells Pillar as peel into a Highlander Yi is promising something the ultimate is specifically built to ignore, and it is the single most important thing a Trundle needs to know here.
audit.corrected: Highlander grants immunity to all slowing effects, so once it is up only Pillar's wall counts — Chomp's slow and the pillar's slow both stop applying. Peel with the terrain, not the tag.
sources: champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json (R Highlander: 'immune to all slowing effects')
champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (Q Chomp slow; E Pillar of Ice, terrain + slow)

audit.whatIsWrong: mid says 'Subjugate's drain and AD steal go blow-for-blow with Highlander' and whys[4] says 'At 6 Subjugate's drain matches his Highlander, keeping the all-in skill-dependent'. Neither ultimate has a number, and neither does Alpha Strike or Meditate.
audit.why: Highlander is a flat 85 seconds. Subjugate is 120/100/80. His ultimate is back long before yours at ranks 1 and 2, and Highlander additionally 'passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist' while champion kills extend its own duration. So the level-6 stage is not a symmetric skill fight, it is a fight he can re-present sooner. Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 at 600 range and its cooldown is shortened by his basic attacks, so it is never a clean twenty seconds. Meditate is a flat 10s channel.
audit.corrected: Highlander is a flat 85s against Subjugate's 120/100/80 — his is up first at ranks 1 and 2. Alpha Strike 20s at rank 1, shortened by his basic attacks. Meditate a flat 10s.
sources: champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json (Q cd 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 range 600, 'Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown'; W cd 10; R cd 85)

audit.whatIsWrong: early says 'Pillar locks him in place if he Alpha Strikes onto you', and spikes[1] says 'Pillar him as he exits Alpha Strike and start the drain'.
audit.why: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable for its duration — 'teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming untargetable'. Anything Trundle aims at him during it, Chomp and Subjugate included, has nothing to land on, so 'start the drain' has to happen after the strike resolves, not during. The pillar itself is placed at a location rather than on a unit, so it is the one tool that still works mid-strike — but it works as terrain on the lane he is travelling, which is a different instruction from 'lock him in place'.
audit.corrected: He is untargetable for the whole of Alpha Strike, so Chomp and Subjugate have to wait until it resolves. Pillar is placed at a location, so drop it on the lane he is crossing.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (E Pillar of Ice, target location, range 1000)
champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json (enemy-dash-deniable: Pillar of Ice vs Alpha Strike)

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is named three times as something Frozen Domain out-paces, and Grievous Wounds appears nowhere in the entry.
audit.why: Meditate is a channelled heal on a flat 10s that also reduces the damage he takes and pauses the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander while he holds it — which is why he channels mid-fight rather than only after. Grievous Wounds is the direct answer and has to already be applied when the channel starts, since the healing arrives during it. Frozen Domain out-racing the heal is true early; it stops being true once Wuju Style's true damage is online.
audit.corrected: Buy Grievous Wounds before the first-item stage: Meditate is a flat 10s channel that heals, cuts incoming damage, and pauses Wuju Style and Highlander while he holds it.

audit.why: The chart is one of the few in this file that agrees with its own prose end to end: Trundle takes Levels 1-3, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 are Skill, first item and two-plus items are Master Yi. That matches the packet's 50.00% over 128 games and matches the mechanics — Chomp's flat 3.5s bullies a champion with a 20s Alpha Strike and no early trade pattern, and the lane inverts the moment Wuju Style's true damage has an item behind it. The only stage I would argue with is Level 6, which the Highlander cooldown makes slightly his rather than even.

notes: NO FULL-LAYER ENTRY EXISTS. CHAMP_FULL.trundle has 71 keys but 'masteryi' is not one of them — instead there is a self-mirror at CHAMP_FULL.trundle.trundle ('W-domain duel — whoever bites first and fights in their zone wins. Trundle wins by trading around Trundle's Subjugate'), which looks like a build slip where the Master Yi row was overwritten with a Trundle-vs-Trundle row. Every edit here is content-layer only; the full layer needs a real entry generated before it can be audited. BIGGEST ADD: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to ALL slowing effects, and the entry sells Pillar of Ice as the answer at every single stage — including 'Pillar peel for your carries' at two-plus items, which is exactly when Highlander is up. Chomp's slow and the pillar's slow both stop applying; only the impassable terrain survives. That reframes Trundle's peel from a tag into a wall. SECOND ADD: Alpha Strike leaves him untargetable for its duration, so the entry's 'Pillar him as he exits Alpha Strike and start the drain' had the ordering wrong — Chomp and Subjugate have no target until it resolves. Pillar is cast at a location, which is why it is the one tool that still functions mid-strike. COOLDOWNS: Highlander is a flat 85s against Subjugate's 120/100/80, so 'Subjugate's drain matches his Highlander' was wrong in the direction that matters — his ultimate returns sooner at ranks 1 and 2, and kills extend its duration and shorten his other abilities. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 but its cooldown is reduced by his basic attacks, so it is never a clean twenty. Meditate is a flat 10s. ANTI-HEAL: Meditate is a channelled heal that also cuts incoming damage and pauses Wuju Style and Highlander while held; Grievous Wounds appeared nowhere in the entry and has to be on him before the channel begins. UNVERIFIED, LEFT ALONE: whether Meditate's channel can be broken — Trundle's kit has no hard CC listed and the kit file's needsResearch block is empty, so I made no claim either way.
